A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-24, before any result (Rule 22, #758). Progress endpoint CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, deaths, unfinished and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; DL3/DL5 and level arrival as diagnostics. SAFETY CONSTRAINT (the owner's word): deaths stay at 0, and scumming itself stays ON - the arms tune its parameters, none removes it (removing scumming outright would cost lives). An arm whose deaths rise cannot be adopted however fast it levels; the read states any death with its cause and a /death-report pack. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; identical plays per arm. Report per arm against ctl: the CL5 endpoint, paired CL5 gained/lost (exact McNemar), the turn of first reaching character level 5 where recorded (a direct speed read), deaths, identical plays. Descriptive (RULES 14); ladder on the owner's word.
experiment.question: At track-p c5501d3c, does scumming leaner (max HP 10, speed ratio 1) - or just the scum alarm off - reach CL5 by 100,000 turns faster while keeping deaths at 0?
